name: clreflect
description: C++ runtime reflection library with clang-based toolchain (Celtoys/clReflect)

tools.name: clReflectScan
tools.description: Parse C++ files with clang and emit reflection databases (CSV/BIN)

tools.name: clReflectMerge
tools.description: Merge per-file reflection databases into a single CSV and generate GetType codegen

tools.name: clReflectExport
tools.description: Convert merged CSV reflection database to a runtime-loadable cppbin (optionally with function addresses from a map file)
